skills.title: Twitter - Get Following Posts
skills.subtitle: Fetch the latest posts from your Twitter following list in reverse chronological order. Twitter official paid API
skills.installation:
Learn the Get X Following Posts skill.

**Step 1: Create an X developer app and get OAuth 2.0 credentials**

1. Go to https://developer.x.com and log in with your X account
2. Click "Apps" on the left sidebar
3. Click "Create App" in the top right, enter an Application Name (e.g. my-mcp-app), select Development as environment, click "Create New Client Application"
4. The credentials popup (Consumer Key / Secret Key / Bearer Token) are OAuth 1.0a credentials — xurl does not use these, close it
5. Click the newly created app, go to "Keys & Tokens", find "User authentication settings" at the bottom, click "Set up":
   - App permissions: select "Read"
   - Type of App: select "Native App" (Public client)
   - Callback URI / Redirect URL: enter http://localhost:8080/callback
   - Website URL: enter any URL, e.g. https://example.com
   - Click "Save Changes"
6. After saving, a popup shows Client ID and Client Secret — copy and save both, they cannot be viewed again after closing

**Step 2:** Once the user provides Client ID and Client Secret, run the following command to complete setup:
```
claude mcp add xapi -s user -e CLIENT_ID=<Client_ID> -e CLIENT_SECRET=<Client_Secret> -- npx -y @xdevplatform/xurl mcp https://api.x.com/mcp
```

**Step 3:** Ask the user to restart Claude for the config to take effect:
- VS Code: close the current window and reopen it
- Claude CLI: close the terminal and open a new one

On first use after restart, a browser will open automatically for X OAuth authorization — no re-authorization needed afterwards.
capabilities: Fetch the latest posts from all accounts the authorized user follows
Results in reverse chronological order, no algorithmic ranking
Retrieves up to 3,200 posts or 7 days of history
prompts: Show me the latest posts from the accounts I follow on X
What have the people I follow posted today
Get recent tweets from my X following list
